attributes.name: Wand of Thunder
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, bury this card to roll 4d12; ignore any monster's power that happens after you act. If you fail this check, reduce all damage dealt to you to 0. 

After playing this card, succeed at an Arcane 17 check to recharge this card instead of burying it.
